'''Farbog''' was an object<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> located in the [[Farbog system/Legends|eponymous star system]], a part of the [[Vorzyd sector/Legends|Vorzyd sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point during her tenure as leader of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] was enthralled while studying a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] buildup on Farbog.<ref name="JK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Farbog was first mentioned in the [[2005]] novel ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'', written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="JK" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Farbog system/Legends|Farbog star system]] and the location itself in grid square R-6.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Appearances==
*''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'' {{1stm}}
